turns.spoken:
The question of who invented the telephone is a complex one. The sources give many details about different inventors and their contributions.

Alexander Graham Bell later patented his version of the telephone.

The controversy surrounding the invention of the telephone was explored in the "Elisha Gray and Alexander Bell telephone controversy". This controversy asked whether Bell and Gray independently invented the telephone, or if Bell stole the invention from Gray.
